scenarios.name: A plant watered today waits a whole interval
steps: Given it is "2026-06-15" on Ava's device
And the test plant is watered every 5 days and was last watered 0 days ago
Then Ava sees the test plant marked "Water in 5 days"

scenarios.name: A long-forgotten plant
steps: Given it is "2026-06-15" on Ava's device
And the test plant is watered every 2 days and was last watered 30 days ago
Then Ava sees the test plant marked "28 days overdue"
